about: Registry of every documented kya feature. Checked by scripts/check-feature-coverage.mjs (rules R1 to R7). Row cli entries: an entry starting with `kya ` is a command, an entry starting with `-` is a flag, any other entry is free text that no rule parses (env vars, install lines). docs: oss and both rows cite package paths (README.md, docs/x.md); hosted rows cite public https URLs. tests: integration or e2e test files that name the feature (its id or one of its cli entries). Package paths, or ../../ paths for hosted tests in the monorepo. A stable or beta row needs at least one tests path that exists and names it. status: stable, beta, planned or flagged (flagged = not live). plan: oss, hosted or both. knownGaps lists today's gaps, each with a reason and the step that clears it.

features.name: Print version
features.summary: Prints the installed kya version and exits.

features.name: One-line start
features.summary: Wires the local MCP gate into your coding host and opens the live report in the background.

features.name: Stop report server
features.summary: Stops the background report server that kya start began.

features.name: Scaffold config
features.summary: Creates the .kya config folder with sample tools and an env example.

features.name: Wire a coding host
features.summary: Writes the KYA MCP server into the config of one coding host (12 hosts).

features.name: Wire PreToolUse hook
features.summary: Writes the PreToolUse hook for claude, grok or kimi.

features.name: Point host at gateway
features.summary: Points a coding host at the local kya gateway.

features.name: Self-update and version banner
features.summary: Updates kya to the latest npm version. kya start warns when a newer release exists.

features.name: Node 22 check and handoff
features.summary: Checks the Node version and hands off to a supported Node 22 or newer.

features.name: Homebrew install
features.summary: Installs kya with Homebrew from The-Pixel-Boys tap.

features.name: Scoop install
features.summary: Installs kya on Windows with Scoop.

features.name: Team rollout: commit plugin pin
features.summary: Adds a tag-pinned plugin marketplace and an enabled plugin to the project settings for everyone who opens the repo.

features.name: Managed-settings JSON for admins
features.summary: Prints the managed-settings JSON an administrator deploys.

features.name: Opt-in usage stats
features.summary: Anonymous usage stats, off by default. Status, on, off, show and reset.

features.name: Global activity record
features.summary: Keeps a global activity log in the KYA home folder. Reports read the last 1 MB of it.

features.name: Activity report
features.summary: Writes the activity report as HTML, JSON or Markdown for the last few days or one session.

features.name: Redacted share link
features.summary: Publishes a redacted summary of the report and prints a public link.

features.name: Natural-language search in report
features.summary: Search box in the activity report.

features.name: Redacted change previews
features.summary: Shows clipped, redacted change previews on the report. Set KYA_DIFF_PREVIEW=0 to turn them off.

features.name: Terminal desk
features.summary: Terminal view with free panes. Actions work on a TTY; --once prints one frame for CI.

features.name: Cost showback
features.summary: Observe-only cost showback inside the activity report.

features.name: Never-list block
features.summary: Blocks never-list tools in the PreToolUse hook. kya hook exits 2 on DENY.

features.name: Advisory hook record
features.summary: Records ALLOW and REQUIRE_APPROVE decisions in the hook. The call proceeds.

features.name: Strict hook mode
features.summary: Strict mode denies advisory decisions in the hook.

features.name: Hosted hook
features.summary: Evaluates each Claude Code tool call on the hosted plane. Beta.

features.name: Local MCP gate server
features.summary: Serves the local MCP gate over HTTP, or over stdio for hosts.

features.name: Local MCP gateway
features.summary: Governs and audits tool calls to any MCP server through a local gateway.

features.name: Destructive names and ADMIN tier denied
features.summary: Gateway policy denies destructive tool names and the ADMIN tier.

features.name: Auto-import of host MCP servers
features.summary: kya start imports MCP servers found in host configs into the gateway. Turn off with --no-gate or KYA_GATE=off.

features.name: Evaluate and record a command
features.summary: Evaluates a command and records it in the trail. It never runs the command.

features.name: Policy evaluate, exit codes
features.summary: Evaluates a tool call against policy and exits with a code per verdict.

features.name: Read-only ORR board
features.summary: Builds a read-only ORR board from producers and writes a report. It is not a second policy point.

features.name: Trust baseline gap report
features.summary: Lists gaps in the Agent Trust Baseline from local evidence.

features.name: Local attestation
features.summary: Records a local attestation for one requirement ID.

features.name: Self-signed evidence bundle
features.summary: Writes a self-signed evidence bundle. It shows integrity and key continuity, not identity.

features.name: EU AI Act mapping
features.summary: Maps certify evidence to EU AI Act articles.

features.name: Import foreign traces
features.summary: Imports traces from other tools into the local trail so the report and certify can read them.

features.name: Detections and fix briefs
features.summary: Finds detections in the trail, groups them into incidents and writes fix briefs for coding agents.

features.name: Endpoint discovery
features.summary: Scans this endpoint for AI agents, IDEs, runtimes and MCP servers.

features.name: Opt-in Firecracker wrap
features.summary: Opt-in sandbox that runs a command inside a Firecracker VM. Not an MCP tool.

features.name: Alert webhooks
features.summary: Sends decision alerts to webhooks set in the config file.

features.name: OTLP export
features.summary: Exports metrics to an OpenTelemetry collector through the gateway OTLP receiver.

features.name: In-process SDK shims
features.summary: Adapters for in-process agent SDKs: Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, OpenAI Agents and Vercel AI.

features.name: Python framework shim
features.summary: Python package shield-kya that gives agent frameworks the KYA checks.

features.name: Claude Code plugin
features.summary: Claude Code plugin for kya, installed from the shield-kya marketplace.

features.name: Codex plugin
features.summary: Codex plugin for kya.

features.name: Copilot CLI plugin
features.summary: Copilot CLI plugin for kya.

features.name: Gemini CLI extension
features.summary: Gemini CLI extension for kya.

features.name: Cursor plugin
features.summary: Cursor plugin manifest for kya.

features.name: VS Code extension
features.summary: VS Code extension for kya, published on the Visual Studio Marketplace.

features.name: GitHub Action kya-certify
features.summary: GitHub Action that runs kya certify in a workflow.

features.name: Dev Container feature
features.summary: Dev Container feature for kya. Not published yet.

features.name: Register an agent
features.summary: Registers an agent on the hosted plane. A human mints the agent.

features.name: Authorize after APPROVED
features.summary: Authorizes a call on the hosted plane after it is allowed or approved. It never runs the write.

features.name: Human approve or reject
features.summary: Lets a person approve or reject an approval ID on the hosted plane.

features.name: Human approval queue
features.summary: Lists the human approval queue on the hosted plane.

features.name: List agents, show one, passport
features.summary: Lists registered agents, shows one agent and prints its observational passport JSON.

features.name: Pause an agent
features.summary: Pauses one agent on the hosted plane.

features.name: Drop session clearance
features.summary: Lowers the clearance of one observed session on the hosted plane.

features.name: Observed sessions
features.summary: Lists observed sessions on the hosted plane.

features.name: Org Hold
features.summary: Holds a call for an org approval path instead of observing it.

features.name: Plane connection and keys
features.summary: Connects the CLI to the hosted plane with an API key, a base URL, a host and an agent ID.

features.name: Hosted login (device code)
features.summary: Links this machine to the hosted console with a device code. Saves a full-workspace key with mode 0600 in ~/.kya/hosted-credentials.json.

features.name: Sign out on this machine
features.summary: Deletes the saved hosted key file on this machine. The key stays active on the server until revoked.

features.name: Hosted calls to action
features.summary: One line, at most once a day, after kya certify (gaps) and kya receipt. Silent in CI, non-TTY, KYA_QUIET, KYA_CTA=0 and config opt-out.

features.name: Incidents and detections (console)
features.summary: Incident and detection screens in the hosted console.

features.name: Gateway console
features.summary: Gateway screens in the hosted console: listeners, routes, backends, policies and playground.

features.name: Endpoint inventory (console)
features.summary: Endpoint inventory screens in the hosted console.

features.name: MCP asset inventory (console)
features.summary: MCP asset inventory screens in the hosted console.

features.name: Slack decision alerts
features.summary: Sends decision alerts to Slack from the hosted plane.

features.name: Teams decision alerts (bot)
features.summary: Sends decision alerts to Microsoft Teams through a bot. Off by default.

features.name: Shared report page
features.summary: A report page shared from the hosted console.

features.name: SSO sign-in
features.summary: Single sign-on for the hosted console.

features.name: Kill and decision metrics
features.summary: Kill and decision metrics screens in the hosted console.

features.name: Claude connector
features.summary: Connects Claude to the hosted KYA tools.

features.name: Hosted console
features.summary: The hosted KYA console, where teams manage agents, approvals and reports.

features.name: Drata link
features.summary: Drata link. Not live: gated by a feature flag.

features.name: Chat link
features.summary: Chat link. Not live: gated by a feature flag.

features.name: AWS Marketplace billing
features.summary: AWS Marketplace billing. Not live: gated by a feature flag.
